error_reason: The Planner agent provided a scientifically inaccurate analysis in the 'Updated Understanding' section. It incorrectly stated that heat energy is converted into mechanical motion and claimed muscle efficiency around 20-25%. In reality, when a person starts to jog, the primary transformation is chemical energy (from stored glycogen and fat) into kinetic energy (motion) and thermal energy (heat). The trace fails to identify the correct source of energy (stored/chemical) and mistakenly lists heat as an input source rather than an output.
